audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the level chart read 'Ryze' in both layers, and the page called this a 'Favoured matchup - difficulty 4/10', against a 46.56% win rate over 131 games and its own whys[] text which hands Sejuani levels 1, 2 and 4-5.
audit.why: Ryze walks into 650-range Arctic Assault to apply Flux, and pre-item Ryze cannot chunk a HP/resist-stacking tank. Packet chart and the mirror agree: Sejuani, Sejuani, Skill, Sejuani, Ryze, Skill, Skill.
audit.corrected: All six disagreeing rows flipped as matched full/content pairs with their ratings, plus diffRating 4/10 -> 7/10 and the difficulty lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].why, phases[5].why and phases[6].why were generic Ryze-favoured filler that contradicted the corrected rows.
audit.why: Levels 4-5 are her spike (Winter's Wrath percent-HP ticks vs pre-item Ryze); first item and two items are genuinely level because Rod of Ages/Seraph's land opposite her tank items and Glacial Prison still cancels a Realm Warp channel.
audit.corrected: Three why lines rewritten inside the length band to state the actual spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated mechanics: (a) that Permafrost 'fires off frozen minions you placed' / can stun 'any frozen target including minions you Fluxed'; (b) the implication that Rune Prison's slow does anything to her. Riot's text: Permafrost 'freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks' — champions only. Fury of the North grants Frost Armor with immunity to slows.
audit.why: Frost stacks come from HER abilities (Winter's Wrath, autos), not from your Flux; and while Frost Armor is up your unfluxed W is a no-op. Spell Flux first is therefore mandatory, since Rune Prison only roots a Fluxed target.
audit.corrected: whys[2], mid and dosFull[0].d rewritten to state the Flux-before-W condition, Frost Armor slow immunity, and the max-Frost-stack stun condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Arctic Assault was quoted as a '13-second cooldown' in early and wants.you[1].
audit.why: Riot's value is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 — 13s is only true near rank 5, and the laning-phase number a player needs is 18s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Both instances corrected to 18s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Glacial Prison was listed as a 130-second cooldown.
audit.corrected: Corrected to 120s at rank 1 in late.

edits.before: At level 1 you have only Q and must walk to melee range to apply Flux — Sejuani punishes exactly this with Arctic Assault knockup into Frost auto. Play behind the wave, stack Manaflow on her when she steps up, and do not force E-walk-up trades she can answer with her dash. Level 2 changes little: her Arctic Assault cooldown is 13 seconds, and she will use it the moment you over-extend after W. At level 3 your E-Q-W loop is live and Flux bounces through minions, so you can apply the cascade from wave-distance rather than her body — this is your first genuine trade window, but only if Arctic Assault is on cooldown and you are not fighting near walls where her knockup trajectory traps you.
edits.after: At level 1 you have only Q and must walk to 615 range to apply Flux — Sejuani punishes exactly this with Arctic Assault knockup into Frost auto. At level 3 your E-Q-W loop is live and Flux bounces through minions, so you can apply the cascade from wave-distance rather than her body — this is your first genuine trade window, but only if Arctic Assault is on cooldown and you are not fighting near walls where her knockup trajectory traps you.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a mana-hungry grind against a tank who does not die to your pre-item burst. Her percent-HP W (Winter's Wrath) ticks meaningful damage even when you are ahead on combo, and she can Permafrost-stun any frozen target including minions you Fluxed — do not stand next to a Fluxed wave or she stuns you through it. Level 6 is your macro breakpoint: Realm Warp cannot kill her in lane, but it makes you dangerous to every other lane she cannot teleport to. Shove the wave, track Arctic Assault, and warp your jungler to a flank rather than trying to solo-kill 65% HP Sejuani through her resistances.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a mana-hungry grind against a tank who does not die to your pre-item burst. Winter's Wrath (W) slows and stacks Frost on a 9-to-5-second cooldown, and at max stacks Permafrost (E) stuns you on a 1.5-second cooldown — watch the Frost count, not the dash. Frost Armor grants slow immunity, so an unfluxed Rune Prison does nothing: lead with Spell Flux. Level 6 is your macro breakpoint: Realm Warp cannot kill her in lane, but it makes you dangerous to every other lane she cannot teleport to. Shove the wave, track Arctic Assault, and warp your jungler to a flank rather than trying to solo-kill 65% HP Sejuani through her resistances.

edits.before: At two items the fight is genuinely even — your near-permanent Flux cycling and rooted chains deal serious DPS into her, but her Glacial Prison ultimate (AOE stun, 130-second cooldown) is a teamfight win condition that can delete your Realm Warp channel before it completes. In grouped fights, bait or wait for her R before you channel. In side-lane, you can split against her because she has no real waveclear answer, but she will hard-engage the moment your W root is on cooldown and her Arctic Assault is up — respect the 1v1 if her team is collapsing. Your real late-game win condition is warp execution: get behind her team, not in front of her face.
